summary: Time-delayed feedback (mode 1.4) on the harmonically forced jet at Re = 2000: starting from the Re = 1900 orbit, the residual falls as t^-2.5 to 6.5e-8 at t = 600 without reaching the tolerance 1e-8.
description: TDF holds the flow on its unstable periodic orbit with the force g (q(t) - q(t - T)), T = 1 / 0.6. The run starts from the orbit at Re = 1900 and runs to t = 600, 360 forcing periods. residu.dat holds the root mean square over the domain of q(t) - q(t - T). plot.py fits residual = c t^p over t >= 100 and writes tdf_decay.dat: p, the residual at t = 100, at t = 300 and at the end, and the largest residual with its time. The residual rises from 8.2e-5 to 3.2e-4 at t = 21.5, then falls as a power law and does not reach residualTol = 1e-8, so the run writes no BF_tpjet0.f00001. The field at t = 600 lies at 1.9e-3 of the Newton orbit of 210_baseflow_newton in the relative velocity norm, the Re = 1900 seed at 1.05e-2 (measured once from the stored results). The values are those of the run named under produced.

decay_exponent.note: Exponent p of residual = c t^p fitted over t >= 100.

residual_t100.note: Root mean square of q(t) - q(t - T) at t = 100.

residual_end.note: At t = 600. Above residualTol = 1e-8: the run does not write the converged field.

residual_peak.note: Largest residual of the run, while the feedback takes hold of the seed.

last_snapshot_time.note: Six snapshots, one every 100 time units; the run ends at endTime = 600.
